subject: Application for JR.AI/ML ENGINEER - Immediate Joiner
body:

subject: Application for AI Engineer (Freshers) - Abhishek Bhosale
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the AI Engineer (Freshers) position. My hands-on experience in building and deploying machine learning applications, as demonstrated in projects like PASE and Credit Risk Modelling System, aligns well with your requirements.

I have strong proficiency in Python, ML concepts (XGBoost, Scikit-learn), and MLOps tools like Docker and MLflow. Additionally, I possess familiarity with LLMs, RAG, and LangChain, which I understand is an added advantage for this role.

I am eager to apply my skills and passion for AI solutions to your team.

subject: Application for Backend Developer (Database) - Supabase - Abhishek Bhosale
body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Backend Developer (Database) - Supabase role at FREVOLT. My experience in designing and optimizing PostgreSQL databases and developing robust backend systems directly aligns with your requirements.

At Konkan Railway Corporation Ltd., I mapped complex PostgreSQL schemas and engineered a Python-based No-Code SQL Generation Engine, demonstrating my ability to design and optimize databases and write complex SQL queries. My background also includes developing RESTful APIs with FastAPI and deploying scalable backend solutions. I am confident my expertise in PostgreSQL, SQL, and API development would be a strong asset to your team.

Best regards,
Abhishek Bhosale
